en: Update checks, preparation and restart have distinct status messages. Preparation waits for you to choose Update and restart.
A successful updated startup shows the installed version once. Ordinary launches and rollbacks do not report upgrade success.
Reorganized the full README into matching English and Simplified Chinese sections, with separate download, installation and update guidance.
zh: 检查、准备和重启分别显示明确状态；准备完成后等待用户点击“更新并重启”。
新版成功启动后仅提示一次已升级版本，普通启动和回滚不误报升级成功。
完整整理 GitHub 首页，中英文结构对应，各自提供版本、安装和更新说明。
